title: Live Deliciously
summary: Every hero took the Horned King's offer, and you knelt to the goat instead of fighting him.

epilogue.title: The Horned King
epilogue.text: The black goat walks into Wickermoor on his hind legs, and the village throws him a feast that never ends.

epilogue.title: His Chosen
epilogue.text: {name} gets everything the goat promised, every last bit, and every year it tastes a little more like ash.

epilogue.title: The Crooked Moon
epilogue.text: The moon grins ear to ear over Wickermoor Hollow, and it never stops.

epilogue.title: Wickermoor Village
epilogue.text: Wickermoor's shutters never open again, and the turnip lanterns burn on in empty windows.

epilogue.title: Phillip and Adela
epilogue.text: Nobody is left to remember Phillip and Adela, and the painting over the inn's hearth curls up in the damp.
